verdict.rationale: Temporal's official CLI ships `temporal server start-dev`, an embedded development service for fast local feedback that starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on the local machine. A pre-built Docker image with dependencies is also documented, so developers can run workflows locally or against a dev instance. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI-testing usage (e.g., SDK test environments or time-skipping test servers), independent hands-on corroboration of local dev/CI workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing

citations.quote: run an embedded development service when you need fast local feedback
This starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your local machine.
Try Temporal Web UI by opening http://localhost:8233 for viewing your sample workflows executing on Temporal.
